verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents API Access & Keys and a developer guide for custom agent skills, indicating a public, documented API surface for automation. However, probes show no discoverable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt, weakening claims of a fully documented, machine-readable API contract. Missing for 10: a public OpenAPI/swagger spec, independent developer corroboration of API usage, and more detailed endpoint documentation beyond the landing page reference.
